map.：透光率 80%–43% 为 CAT2（日常）、43%–8% 为 CAT3（强阳: Transmittance of 80%-43% is CAT2 (everyday), 43%-8% is CAT3 (strong sun), and below 8% is CAT4 (snow and sea, not for driving). Grey lenses preserve colour fidelity and brown lenses raise contrast.
map.：黄片提对比适雾天/靶场但失真，绿片舒缓，驾驶选灰/茶 CAT3 不超 8% 下: Yellow lenses raise contrast, suiting fog and shooting ranges but distort colour; green lenses are soothing. For driving choose grey or brown CAT3 without going below the 8% limit.

map.染色越深越护眼？: Does a darker tint protect the eyes better?
map.否。过深在暗处迫瞳散大反进更多紫外（若无 UV 镀膜），须选带 UV400 的片: No. Too dark a tint forces the pupil to dilate in low light, which lets in more ultraviolet if there is no UV coating, so choose lenses rated UV400.
map.CAT4 为什么禁驾驶？: Why is CAT4 not allowed for driving?
map.透光<8% 太暗，隧道/夜路危险，仅雪原海上用。: Below 8% transmittance it is too dark and dangerous in tunnels and on night roads, so it is for snowfields and the sea only.
